race.description: Sharp Office Newcastle Gold Cup September 18 Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: STALLONE (2) returned from a lengthy spell with a determined on-pace win over 1400m at Illawarra Grange. Can offset the weight increase from the rails draw and can make it two on the bounce.  EXTRA HEIGHTS (3) shapes as the main danger after he resumed in a strong contest with a respectable fifth over 1250m at Canterbury in BM72 grade. Lone win came second up and has the ability to overcome the awkward draw. GALACTIC FORCE (6) unlucky not to have a few more wins on the record and backs up quickly after he faded in the run when fourth over 1300m at Hawkesbury. Can get over from the gate and play a leading role. ONMALONE (5) frustrating gelding with just one win from his twelve starts. Knocked up late from the rails draw with a plugging fourth over 1200m at Gosford in this class. Respect.
